definition.event_relabel: only the frozen signal day in state 0 is relabelled to -1/+1
definition.persistent_relabel: audit-only counterfactual: a frozen entry signal carries through the rest of its base-zero run; never used for the formal state output
definition.persistent_relabel_conflict_continue: causal audit-only alternative: when both signals fire in state 0, continue the already active direction; a first conflict with no active direction stays 0
definition.directional_return: state * O2O_H1 for -1/+1; raw O2O_H1 for state 0
definition.segment_win: a complete holding segment is a win when compounded directional O2O_H1 return is positive
definition.gap_bridge: retrospective diagnostic only: fill at most 1 or 2 neutral days when both neighboring states have the same direction; conflicts are never bridged

quality_assessment.interpretation: diagnostic only; zero-state shortening does not automatically prove directional return improvement
